User: I've actually cut back a lot on eating fast food just because the prices keep going up. And, I mean, not just with fast food, with everything, so we have less money. So I haven't been going to fast food as much as I used to. I've probably, you know, I used to go maybe twice a week and now I'm down to once every two weeks.
Agent: Thank you for sharing that. It sounds like rising prices have significantly impacted your fast-food habits, leading you to reduce how often you go.

Compared to your last fast-food order, what changed today, if anything? Could you pick the biggest driver and explain if it was your mood, cravings, schedule, budget, health goals, social plans, or convenience?
